Regarding the use of Matrix as the namespace in Fin.VecNotation: looking at the defs and using, it's no confuse to name matrix, however, it seems to have almost nothing to do with the Matrixin mathlib for mainly using in the context of linear algebra, so I think it may be inappropriate as a namespace. what do you think?
I don(t hold any strong opinion about this naming, but the simple issue is that in our impl we use the former sense, and as a result of definition like Matrix.map accordingly, it conflicted to Matrix.map.

So, this is a suggestion that consider renaming Matrix namespace in VecNotation to something else. (At the very least, I'd like a good name for Matrix in the former, if someone could suggest one...)

FYI: @Palalansoukî
